description: Every prop type any map can place. A type gives defaults; a placement in a map file gives its top-left x, y and only the fields that differ (null removes a default). Fields are the authored appearance options the prop artists read (decorType, color, interactionType, ...). movable: the player can grab and push it. A type that names a family is a preset of it: a family is a kind of piece one artist draws, and its look is a schema of the fields a type or a placement may set (look: {...}, field by field).

bentwood_chair.description: A bentwood cafe chair seen from above: a round seat in a wooden ring, a curved back. Turns to its face.

seats.note: one seat colour is chosen per chair

upholstered_seat.description: A tufted armchair or sofa: a back, two deep arms, one cushion per seat, sometimes a knitted throw. Turns to its face.

upholstery_dark.note: the shadow colour for each upholstery colour, in the same order

cushioned.note: a scatter cushion in the first seat

throw.note: how often a knitted throw lies over it

booth_bench.description: A padded booth bench with its back to the wall. Turns to its face.

cushion_bench.description: A window bench: cushions in turn along it, pillows against the glass. Turns to its face.

cushions.note: used in turn, starting from where the bench stands

round_table.description: A round wooden table, laid: a candle jar, cups, a pastry and a bud vase, or books, mugs and a candle.

cafe_table.description: A small table, square or round, laid: a booth table has a candle jar, cups and sugar; a side table a cup and a glass.

cafe_counter.description: A cafe bar: a wooden top with a bright edge, slatted front, a register, a tip jar and cups, and a pastry case at the end. Placed vertical it is a side run with a cake dome and a biscotti jar.

espresso_machine.description: An espresso machine: two group heads, cups warming on top, a pressure gauge whose needle moves.

coffee_grinder.description: A coffee grinder: a hopper of beans over a dark body.

mug_shelf.description: A wall shelf of mismatched mugs on hooks.

potted_plant.description: A terracotta pot with leaves fanned out, swaying a little; a fern has more, longer, narrower fronds.

fireplace.description: A brick fireplace on a wall: a stone hearth, crossed logs and glowing embers in the firebox, candlesticks on the mantel.

bookcase.description: A case of well-read spines, a few leaning.

record_player.description: A sideboard with a turntable turning and a stack of sleeves.

chalkboard_easel.description: A chalkboard on legs with two lines of chalk.

range_stove.description: A kitchen range: four burners, a pot of soup on one, a copper pan on another, knobs along the front.

double_sink.description: A steel double sink with a tap between the bowls.

prep_table.description: A butcher-block table: a scored loaf, a board and knife, a bowl of lemons.

fridge.description: A fridge seen from above: two doors, handles, notes and a drawing stuck on.

notes.note: the first a note, the second a drawing

jar_shelf.description: Shelves of jars and tins in two rows; vertical runs them down the shelf.

stencilled_crate.description: A wooden crate with a stencilled word.

flour_sacks.description: Flour sacks slumped together, each with a red band.

workbench.description: A craft bench: walnut on steel, tools on a pegboard lip, a vise, a parts tray, a holo-schematic tablet with a scanline drifting down it, a soldering iron whose tip glows.

velvet_sofa.description: A velvet sofa facing north, its back along the bottom edge: deep arms, two seat cushions, scatter cushions and a knit throw over one arm.

glass_fireplace.description: A linear glass fireplace set into a stone slab, its flames flickering along the glass.

lamp_table.description: A small table with a pleated table lamp on it; a nightstand has a drawer pull.

pull.note: a brass drawer pull on the front

oval_coffee_table.description: An oval coffee table: two books and a vase of flowers.

slipper_chair.description: A rounded slipper chair, the back to the south.

open_bookshelf.description: A low bookshelf of spines with gaps for ornaments, a plant at one end.

media_console.description: A media console: two speakers and a turntable between them, the record turning.

leafy_plant.description: A cream pot with seven broad leaves, swaying a little.

floor_lamp.description: A floor lamp from above: its pleated shade.

shade.note: the lamp library fixture it wears

panel_fridge.description: A panelled fridge, a brass trim along the top, the doors meeting in the middle.

kitchen_counter.description: A run of quartz counter with a walnut front edge; it may hold a sink or an induction hob.

gas_range.description: A five-burner gas range in black steel, brass knobs along the back.

bar_island.description: An open bar island: a quartz top with waterfall ends, three brass pendants above, a fruit bowl and a glass.

clothing_dyer.description: The clothing dyer: a walnut cabinet with three dye vats, a bolt of cloth, a fan of swatches and the steamer.

bar_cart.description: A bar cart of brass and smoked glass on two wheels: bottles, a decanter, an ice bucket and two coupes.

bottles.note: the three bottles: red wine, a green bottle, whiskey

bar_stool.description: A round bar stool: a brass ring round the seat.

queen_bed.description: A queen bed, the headboard against the top wall: a tufted headboard, pillows, a duvet with the sheet folded over and a knit throw at the foot.

wardrobe.description: A tall wardrobe: two doors, brass handles.

dressing_table.description: A dressing table against the east wall: a round mirror, scent bottles, a stool in front.

oval_tub.description: A freestanding oval tub strewn with petals, the water rippling.

double_vanity.description: A double marble vanity against the south wall: two basins, brass taps.

walk_in_shower.description: A walk-in shower: a tiled floor, a glass screen, a brass rain head.

towel_rail.description: A towel rail with two towels over it.

lounger.description: A veranda lounger, the head to the north, a towel over the foot.

bistro_set.description: A round bistro table between two chairs, flowers on it.

telescope.description: A brass telescope on a tripod, slowly sweeping the sky.

dining_set.description: A round dining table for six, the chairs tucked in, a posy on a lazy susan, two candles and the places set.

baby_grand.description: A baby grand in black lacquer, the lid up: the gold harp and strings, the keys to the south, the bench.

tufted_bench.description: A tufted bench on brass legs, a throw folded on it.

chaise_longue.description: A velvet chaise longue: a raised back end, a bolster, an open book on a throw.

fire_bowl.description: A fire bowl: a travertine ring, a bronze bowl, a bed of glowing embers.

patio_sofa.description: An outdoor sofa: a teak frame, cream cushions, a pillow; the back along the outer side (the east side when it faces west).

trough_planter.description: A stone trough planter, leaves trailing over its south lip, two flowers.
